task: Phase 2d Task 5b -- 2d's own field WITH a signal: does the defect's repair reach 2c's difficulty, and is it separable?
what_this_is_a_measurement_OF: Not a knob setting. The 2c probe localised essentially the whole 24.4-to-43.94 difficulty gap
in ONE difference: 2c's series carry 2.0 + 0.3 x (t - t.mean()) and 2d's carry NOTHING, while
both configs fit constant + trend. Removing the signal from 2c's own field takes it from
So 2d's field builder is missing a term the whole design assumes: section 11.2's subject is
trend uncertainty, section 16.2's benchmark is for a trend-estimation package, and real
altimetry has sea-level rise. This measures the REPAIR, and the difficulty is a consequence
of it rather than its purpose.

instrument.field_parameters: 2d's own BASE -- sigma 1.0, rho 0.8, white 0.4, white/sigma 0.40
instrument.signal_added: 2.0 + 0.3 x (t - t.mean()), 2c's own values, so the two are comparable
instrument.also_measured: a half-amplitude trend (0.15/yr) and a trend with no constant offset

readings.name: does 2d's field reach 2c's difficulty from the signal alone?
prediction: 2d's parameters plus 2c's signal land in [38, 48] iterations per point -- at or near 2c's
own 43.94, and above its published 40.79.
The mechanism: the 2c probe's decomposition attributes 18.25 of the 18.3-iteration gap to
the signal, and the remaining differences between the fields -- white/sigma 0.40 against
0.35-0.71, rho 0.8 against 0.42-1.04 -- were measured on the ladder to be worth a few
iterations at most.
IF IT HOLDS, the rung lands at 2c's difficulty and the pre-decided stop applies cleanly:
a null there is a null at the difficulty where 2c measured a 42.28% saving.

reading: The signal does not carry 2d's field to 2c's range on 2d's parameters, so the two fields
differ in more than the signal and the decomposition is incomplete. The remaining
distance would then have to come from the noise floor after all -- the calibration
ladder is the measured alternative and is not deleted.
ACTION: report the shortfall with the ladder beside it and take the rung's shape as an
explicit decision rather than reaching for a second knob.
2d's field with a signal is HARDER than 2c's was, which would make the rung's difficulty
an extrapolation beyond the range any saving has been measured at -- 2c's curve stops at
40.79. A null there would be a null outside the evidence, which is weaker than a null
inside it.
ACTION: reduce the trend's amplitude to land inside 2c's range rather than beyond it,
and record that the amplitude was chosen to stay inside measured territory.

readings.name: is it separable? -- the constraint that voids a rung
prediction: Misclassification stays at or below 0.25 at 2d's white/sigma of 0.40, materially below
The mechanism: 2c's 0.375 was measured at white/sigma 0.45-0.71, and the calibration
ladder put misclassification at 0.19-0.25 at white/sigma 1.0 and 0.00-0.06 at 0.40. The
signal is profiled out by the concentrated objective, so it should cost iterations without
costing separability -- and that is exactly the property that would make the noise-floor
route unnecessary.

reading: The signal costs separability as well as iterations, so the two constraints are coupled
on this construction after all and a rung is at risk of its own interior null firing --
P(Binom(12, 0.30) >= 7) is about 6% per row and the null reads two seed rows.
ACTION: report the coupling. A rung is not run at a setting expected to void itself.

refuted_from_below.when: misclassification is exactly zero at every setting
reading: Not a refutation of the repair, but a warning about the SMEAR reading rather than the
null: at a baseline of zero the majority rule needs the artifact to flip more than half
a row from perfect classification, which is the same forfeit the easy rung hit. The
profile stays the primary reading either way.

readings.name: which half of the signal does the work -- the trend or the offset?
prediction: The TREND does the work and the constant offset does little. A constant is one column of
the design matrix and is absorbed almost exactly; a trend of 0.3/yr over 52 years is a
rise of 15.6 against sigma ~1, which is what a moment-based cold start has to contend
with before the optimizer sees it.
Half the trend amplitude should land materially below the full one but still well above
the no-signal 24.4.
what_would_NOT_refute_anything: Any ordering among the three signal variants that keeps all of them above the no-signal
baseline. This reading exists to say WHICH part of the repair matters, so that the field
builder's new term can be specified with a reason rather than copied from 2c.

what_this_probe_does_not_establish: Nothing about hysteresis: independent series, no boundary, no neighbours, no warm starts.
Nothing about whether the three shipped rungs' null transfers to a signal-bearing field --
that is what a rung would test, and it is a scope decision rather than a measurement.
And no number here is a 2d result.
